description: Create a job alert: a saved search over ANY of the job search's filters whose new postings are delivered to the person on the channels their account has connected (email, Telegram, the mobile app, a webhook) — this conversation is not notified. e.g. remote senior Go roles in the EU paying at least 80k EUR is {"filters":{"work_mode":["remote"],"seniority":["senior"],"skills":["go"],"regions":["eu"],"salary_currency":["EUR"]},"salary_min":80000}. The search must narrow the catalogue. Values not in a filter's vocabulary are dropped and named in ignored_params. Leave channels empty for the default (email when alert mail is on, otherwise the first connected channel). The answer's alert.id addresses the alert from then on. Effect: saves the search on the account (or reuses the one already selecting the same postings) and delivers it on each channel; nothing existing is changed.

channels.description: Where to deliver. Only a channel the account has connected is accepted.

filters.description: Facet filters, the job search's own. Each value is a list of values from the facets tool.

name.description: A name for the alert (1-100 characters). Omit to name it from its filters.

query.description: Free-text query, with the job search's operators.

salary_max.description: Only postings whose stated salary ceiling is at most this.

salary_min.description: Only postings whose stated salary floor is at least this, in the posting's currency — pair it with filters.salary_currency.

name: subscribe
title: Create a job alert
